event-FWSecretPassageEvent.01: While walking to the secret woods, you stumble across a small trail hidden in the foliage.
event-FWSecretPassageEvent.02.FirstTime: As you follow it, you discover a hidden part of the woods you've never seen before...
event-FWSecretPassageEvent.02.Subsequent: As you follow it, you find that you're on the same path to that hidden part of the woods you discovered before...
event-FWSecretPassageEvent.03: It may end up being a long walk, but what mysteries might you find if you explore deeper inside? There could be hidden treasures or beautiful sights... or there could be strange magical things.
event-FWSecretPassageEvent.04: It looks like there are two paths you can take: one leading west, which feels wide and curious, and the other leading south-east, which seems lonely and ominous.
event-FWSecretPassageEvent.04.MysteryMod: It looks like there are two paths you can take: one leading west and the other leading south-east.
event-FWKorokRockEvent.01: As you travel further in, you come to a clearing with a circle of rocks...
event-FWKorokRockEvent.02: Something about this circle of rocks seems... odd. There's one conspicuously off to the side which has broken the circle.
event-FWKorokRockEvent.03: You could move the rock back into the circle, but would that really be the best thing to do?
event-FWKorokRockEvent.07: A junimo appeared! It gave you a seed before disappearing again.
event-FWKorokRockEvent.08: Best to leave it. Who knows what might happen? Perhaps it was moved for a reason.
event-FWKorokRockEvent.09: At first glance, it looks like there's only one path to the south, from which you can hear splashing, but when you look closely, you can also see a small hidden path through the trees to the west, which smells crisp and inviting.
event-FWKorokRockEvent.09.MysteryMode: At first glance, it looks like there's only one path to the south, but when you look closely, you can also see a small hidden path through the trees to the west.
event-FWPondEvent.01: As you walk, you hear the quiet sounds of water moving...
event-FWPondEvent.02: The pond is clear enough that you can see all the way to the fallen tree at the bottom, now home to small darting fish and various aquatic plants.
event-FWPondEvent.03: You could go for a swim, or it would be nice to sit on the bank and relax for a while.
event-FWPondEvent.07: Despite the slight chill in the fall air, the water is pleasant and feels nice against your skin.
event-FWPondEvent.08: A fish bit your toe! You decide to get out of the water.
event-FWPondEvent.09: It's peaceful sitting by the water's edge. You watch the fish as they swim to and fro.
event-FWPondEvent.10: After a while, you decide it's time to keep moving.
event-FWPondEvent.11: There are clear, wide paths to the east, which has a strong floral scent, and south-east, which smells crisp and inviting, but on your second look, you also spot an almost invisible path to the south-west, which is so dark you can barely see.
event-FWPondEvent.11.MysteryMode: There are clear, wide paths to the east and south-east, but on your second look, you also spot an almost invisible path to the south-west.
event-FWGravesEvent.01: Something shining ahead catches your eye and as you turn the corner, you see a large sparkling boulder...
event-FWGravesEvent.02: As you get closer though, you see a large gravestone in front of it and a number of other graves scattered nearby.
event-FWGravesEvent.03: A chill runs down your spine. Something about this place feels unsettling, like there are spirits lurking about...
event-FWGravesEvent.04: Maybe if you leave an offering of money at the grave, the spirits will be settled?
event-FWGravesEvent.08: It doesn't feel like anything has changed.
event-FWGravesEvent.09: The creeping feeling of unease settles.
event-FWGravesEvent.10: As you look to the south, you see two paths, one west-ish, which is so dark you can barely see, and the other east-ish, which smells crisp and inviting.
event-FWGravesEvent.10.MysteryMode: As you look to the south, you see two paths, one west-ish and the other east-ish.
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.01: Walking along the path, the smell of apples in the air becomes almost impossible to ignore...
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.02: The grove of apple trees is filled with mature fruit, some of it so ripe that it's fallen to the ground and begun to ferment.
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.06: The apples shake loose from the tree with a series of thumps. You bend down and pick them up...
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.10: The apple is perfectly sweet, its crisp skin parting with a snap between your teeth. It's possibly the best apple you've ever eaten.
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.11: At the far end of the grove, the path splits into a fork, with one path leading east, which has a strong floral scent, and the other heading west, which feels sinister and foreboding.
event-FWAppleGroveEvent.11.MysteryMode: At the far end of the grove, the path splits into a fork, with one path leading east and the other heading west.
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.01: As you draw closer, the trees part to reveal a beautiful meadow of fall flowers...
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.02: The fairy looks at you curiously, perhaps wondering what a human is doing so deep in the woods.
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.06: The fairy giggles and, with a puff of magic, creates a small glowing stone for you in thanks.
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.07: You call the fairy a number of creatively insulting names in retaliation for the disordered harvesting that has been wreaked upon your fields.
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.08: With a puff of magic, the fairy turns one of your items into rot!
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.09: Close by, there's a path that leads south, which has a glint of orange ahead, but there's also a wider path leading to the west, where you can hear birds chirping.
event-FWFlowerFieldEvent.09.MysteryMode: Close by, a path leads south, but there's also a wider path leading to the west.
event-FWScaryPathEvent.01: The trees grow so dense and tightly-packed here that you can barely see a thing...
event-FWScaryPathEvent.02: It would be best to leave quickly.
event-FWScaryPathEvent.03: You spy the faint glimmer of a path to the south, which feels a little forgotten, as well as a shrouded path to the north-west, which feels sinister and foreboding.
event-FWScaryPathEvent.03.MysteryMode: You spy the faint glimmer of a path to the south as well as a shrouded path to the north-west.
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.01: The winding path leads you to a small tower in a clearing...
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.02: The tower is squat and clearly ancient, with vines and mushrooms growing around it. A field of amaranth has been planted nearby and the bones of an unknown animal lie in clear view just behind it...
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.06: You pick a bundle of amaranth...
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.07: ...and another one! Better not take any more though.
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.08: You decide it would be best to leave, but in which direction? There's a path heading west, which has a glint of orange ahead, or a narrow path through the trees to the south, where you can hear birds chirping.
event-FWWitchTowerEvent.08.MysteryMode: You decide it would be best to leave, but in which direction? There's a path heading west or a narrow path through the trees to the south.
event-FWPumpkinPatchEvent.01: As the trees clear, you see a small wild field of bright orange pumpkins ahead...
event-FWPumpkinPatchEvent.02: With the freedom to grow as they like, the pumpkins here have become enormous!
event-FWPumpkinPatchEvent.05: The pumpkins aren't growing from the tree itself - instead, an enterprising pumpkin vine has grown up and around the tree, with its fruit hanging from the tree's branches.
event-FWPumpkinPatchEvent.06: The path to the east, which feels a little forgotten, is wide and clear, but there's also a narrow little path through the trees to the north-east, where you can see spores in the sunlight.
event-FWPumpkinPatchEvent.06.MysteryMode: The path to the east is wide and clear, but there's also a narrow little path through the trees to the north-east.
event-FWWishingWellEvent.01: The drip of water echoes a little as you round the corner and spy a small overgrown well...
event-FWWishingWellEvent.02: You peer down into the well. At the distant bottom, you can see something shiny glimmering beneath the water. It looks like it's a wishing well.
event-FWWishingWellEvent.06: Throw a rock in the well
event-FWWishingWellEvent.07: Nothing happened. Perhaps your wish will come true in the future, or perhaps not.
event-FWWishingWellEvent.08: As you throw the coins into the well, you suddenly see a brighter gleam in the well's bucket. As you pull it up, you find...
event-FWWishingWellEvent.09: A frozen tear was caught in the bucket!
event-FWWishingWellEvent.10: As you throw the coins into the well, you suddenly see a brighter gleam in the well's bucket. As you pull it up, you find...
event-FWWishingWellEvent.11: A diamond was caught in the bucket!
event-FWWishingWellEvent.12: Turning away from the well, you see two paths ahead of you: one to the south-east, where something ahead is flashing eerily, and one directly south, which smells sweetly nostalgic.
event-FWWishingWellEvent.12.MysteryMode: Turning away from the well, you see two paths ahead of you: one to the south-east and one directly south.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.01: You can hear birds whistling and chirping ahead as they feast on forest berries...
event-FWForestGroveEvent.02: The sweet scent of blackberries and plums is almost overwhelming. Many are half-eaten by birds, animals, and insects, but there's a few still untouched.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.04: Investigate the sapling in the shade
event-FWForestGroveEvent.05: You collect the first of the shaken-off blackberries...
event-FWForestGroveEvent.06: ...a few more that had spilled loose...
event-FWForestGroveEvent.07: ...and the final berries that somehow ended up over here.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.08: It's a pomegranate tree sapling! Looks like it's struggling to grow in the shade of the big plum tree nearby.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.09: You carefully pull up the little sapling. Hopefully it will grow better on your farm in the sunlight.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.10: The path ahead curves to the east, where you can see spores in the sunlight, and to the south, where something ahead is flashing eerily.
event-FWForestGroveEvent.10.MysteryMode: The path ahead curves to the east and to the south.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.01: The rich smell of fall leaves and forest soil fills your nose as you find yourself in a clearing with mushrooms growing everywhere you look...
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.03: Look at the mushroom on the tree stump
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.06: There's a variety of different mushrooms growing here...
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.07: It looks like a young mushroom tree has started growing from this tree trunk. If you're careful, you might be able to snap it off and replant it back home.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.08: You got a mushroom tree seed! Hopefully it will grow into a fine mushroom tree on your farm.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.09: A fairy appeared behind you! They don't seem like the fairy who visits your farm from time to time... There's something oddly blank about their pale eyes.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.10.1: Long has it been since last one of your kind stepped into our realm...
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.10.2: Will you take some refreshments? It would be poor indeed if we were to breach the laws of hospitality.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.11: The strawberries are impossibly ripe, as though despite the season they were picked only moments ago, and the mead glimmers in its bottle like liquid gold. It's hard to resist.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart1.12: You're not really in the mood for foraging right now, so you decide to keep walking.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.07: The chanterelle is perfectly ripe, with a sweet peppery flavor. It's delicious! You decide to pick one to take with you as well.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.08: The common mushroom is perfectly ripe, with a mild nutty flavor. It's delicious! You decide to pick one to take with you as well.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.09: The morel is perfectly ripe, with a strong nutty flavor. It's delicious! You decide to pick one to take with you as well.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.10: The red mushroom is bitter and makes you feel nauseated...
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.11: You're not sure how a magma cap is growing here, but it has a rich spicy flavor. It's delicious! You decide to pick one to take with you as well.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventEat.12: The purple mushroom is perfectly ripe, with a rich earthy flavor. It's delicious! You decide to pick one to take with you as well.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.01: You're about to reach for the food when something makes you pause. You vaguely remember your grandmother telling you stories of the fae, and they weren't always pleasant.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.06: The strawberry is the most delicious thing you've ever tasted. Its juices stain your chin and fingers as you eat until there's none left.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.07: As you finish licking off the last of the juice, you're suddenly overcome by an overwhelming tiredness...
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.08: As you drift off to sleep, you finally remember what your grandmother used to tell you: 'never trust food gifted by the fae'.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.09: The mead is the most delicious thing you've ever tasted. It spills over your lips and chin as you drink until there's none left.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.10: As you finish tipping back the last few drops of mead, you're suddenly overcome by an overwhelming tiredness...
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.11: As you drift off to sleep, you finally remember what your grandmother used to tell you: 'never trust food gifted by the fae'.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.12: You politely explain to the fae that you aren't able to eat at the moment.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.13.1: Very well then. Instead, will you speak with us of things in your realm? It has been an age since last we heard news.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.13.2: In exchange, we will reward you for your time.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.16: Share your memories of Zuzu City
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.19: After speaking for a while, the fae finishes speaking and disappears again, leaving behind a pouch of glowing dust as a gift.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.20.1: Rude. So unspeakably rude, to first come uninvited into our realm only to then spurn our hospitality and leave without saying the proper farewells.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.20.2: Is this how all humans have become in the ages since last we spoke? We will have none of it.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.20.3: As one final gift before we part, I will unburden you of that metal that weighs you down so.
event-FWMushroomsSubEventFae.21: After the fae vanishes, you realise that some of your money has also disappeared! You've lost 5000$.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart2.01: The mushroom clearing lies at a crossroads: one path heads east, which smells sweetly nostalgic, while the other goes west, where something ahead is flashing eerily.
event-FWMushroomsEventPart2.01.MysteryMo: The mushroom clearing lies at a crossroads: one path heads east, while the other goes west.
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.01: The trees in front of you are broken and scorched, and there's an odd glow ahead...
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.02: The meteorite glows and pulses erratically, and the faint noise emitted by the spheres surrounding it makes your skin prickle.
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.04: Look at one of the spheres
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.05: Get out of here as fast as possible
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.06: As your hand brushes against the rock, the contact zaps you! This is no ordinary meteorite.
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart1.07: As the sphere bursts, the acrid smell of slime almost overwhelms you, but you persevere long enough to pull loose an odd egg.
event-FWMeteoriteSubEvent.03: With effort, you managed to knock loose a bar of iridium!
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart2.01: Gazing over the eerie crater, you shiver a little and decide to leave it behind you.
event-FWMeteoriteEventPart2.02: There's only one path leading away from here. You think you might be nearing the end of your walk.
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.01: As you walk, a sweet smell in the air grows stronger...
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.02: It's a meadow of sweet gem berries! Looking at their gleaming fruit makes you feel calm, somehow.
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.03: You're tempted to pick a few and take them with you.
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.07: You harvest one sweet gem berry...
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.08: ...and one more! You decide to leave the others where they are.
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.09: You carefully harvest seeds from some of the semi-ripe berries.
event-FWSweetGemsEvent.10: Along the path to the east, you catch a glimpse of the familiar statue of Old Master Cannoli and decide you've spent enough time in the woods. It's time to go back home.
